title: Legacy Font to Unicode Converter
tagline: Turn text typed in FM, DL or Bamini fonts into Unicode that works everywhere.
output_empty: The converted text appears here as you type.
paste_blocked: Your browser blocked pasting. Press Ctrl+V in the box instead.
copy_failed: Couldn't copy automatically. The text is selected: press Ctrl+C.
no_fonts: Font tables have not been added yet.
how_step1: Choose the font the text was typed in.
how_step2: Paste the text, or type it with the same keys you used before.
how_step3: Copy the Unicode result into any app, website or document.
privacy: Your text never leaves your browser.
offline: Once loaded, the converter also works offline.
docx_hint: Fonts are detected automatically. English text, formatting, tables, headers and footers stay as they are.
docx_none: No FM, DL or Bamini text was found in this file.
docx_legacy_doc: This is an old .doc file. Open it in Word, choose File → Save As → Word Document (.docx), then try again.
docx_not_docx: This isn't a .docx Word document, or the file is damaged.
